ayat.ar: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
ayat.en: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

ayat.ar: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝ إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayat.en: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.
Surely, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
So remember Me; I will remember you.

ayat.ar: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ
ayat.en: And when My servants ask you concerning Me, indeed I am near.

ayat.ar: وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥ
ayat.en: And whoever relies upon Allah, then He is sufficient for him.
Do not despair of the mercy of Allah.
My Lord, increase me in knowledge.
Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you.
And to your Lord direct your longing.
